footer:
<script >
window.addEventListener('load', function () {
    var x = 0;
    var timer = setInterval(function () {
        var confirmation = document.querySelector('.wpforms-confirmation-container-full');
        if (
            confirmation &&
            confirmation.getClientRects().length > 0 &&
            window.getComputedStyle(confirmation).visibility !== 'hidden'
        ) {
            if (x === 0) {
                gtag('event', 'website_forms', {
                    event_category: 'form',
                    event_label: window.location.pathname
                });
                x = 1;
            }
            clearInterval(timer);
        }
    }, 250);

    // Track telephone link clicks
    document.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach(function (link) {
        var href = link.getAttribute('href') || '';
        if (href.toLowerCase().startsWith('tel:')) {
            link.addEventListener('click', function () {
                gtag('event', 'calls_to_website', {
                    event_category: 'number',
                    event_label: this.getAttribute('href')
                });
            });
        }
    });
});
</script>
